decision_rule: Field-drift review of the 85 items in ledger/audit/field-drift-ships-2026-11-13.json. For each, the current plants.csv field was compared with every evidence row of its claim (value, quote, reasoning). confirmed_format: the flagged token is a reformatted row date, an abbreviation (SAW, FCAW), a read date, or a day count computed from a row date. already_consistent: the field changed after Nov 13 and now matches its rows. trimmed (corrected): the field carries a clause no row and no fetched page supports, or a wrong value; plants_csv_value is the trimmed field. row_proposed (corrected, error_kind other): the clause is true and on a page (often a page already cited on a sibling claim or on this row), but no row of this claim carries it; the row to add or extend is in rows_proposed, quotes machine-checked against a fresh fetch. A publication date is only 'confirmed' when the row carries it (in quote or URL).

method: Read CLAUDE.md, tools/AGENT_BRIEF.md and the run_log ships, mining-consultation and session-2 rules. Re-ran tools/field_drift_check.py --all on the current ledger to see which of the 85 items still flag. For each item, printed the current plants.csv field and every evidence row of its claim. Fresh fetches 2026-11-19 with tools/fetch_page.fetch(with_raw=True) into a new cache (about 80 pages: company sites, news, job pages incl. raw JSON-LD and job JSON), plus board APIs: UKG LoadSearchResults (Philly), Workday jobs POST (Eastern), Ashby posting API (Saronic), HII search pages. Every proposed quote was split on ' ... ' and each fragment checked with fetch_page.norm against the fetched visible text plus raw source (negative test: 'CVN 78', '1,500', 'impulse tank' correctly not found); all are 300 characters or fewer. Tokens not found were grepped across ledger/evidence.csv and ledger/inbox/*.json before trimming. No web search used. No ledger file edited.
apply_note: Do NOT run tools/apply_factcheck.py on this file as-is: field-only rows have source_url '' and apply_factcheck matches such a row to EVERY evidence row of the claim (it would stamp unchecked base rows, and Heartland's unreachable row, as confirmed or corrected). Apply by hand: (1) for each row whose outcome starts with 'trimmed', set plants.csv <field> = plants_csv_value; (2) upsert each rows_proposed entry into evidence.csv on (claim_id, source_url). 'replace existing row' entries keep the old value and quote and append clauses (value = old value + '; ' + new clause; quote = old quote + ' ... ' + new fragments); tag, source_type, archive_url and reasoning are the old row's; replaces_value/replaces_quote show the row being replaced. Two old quotes were shortened to fit 300 characters, keeping their date and title fragments (items 24 SeaPower: the $3 billion sentence cut to 'a planned investment of more than $3 billion'; 43 Great Lakes: 'The Great Lakes Towing Company announced today that it has' cut; soft hyphens kept byte for byte).
